selection: Current report/history, protocol, project Python/config/checks, nonredundant text records; normalized core archive scientific code/data/runs/checks. No tensor checkpoints, opaque archives, repeated monitoring snapshots, SSH maintenance logs, or third-party language corpus bodies.
redaction_policy: Replace private training/backup hostnames with .example.invalid; edit public stage report to consolidate final backup status; add history banners. Preserve recorded scientific metrics. Source hashes in historical receipts refer to original bytes.
